title: Fitness The Eighty Minute Engine (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, rugby is eighty minutes plus
The last ten win the game, son, fitness must
The engine you build in pre season

[Verse 1]
Aerobic base built up over twelve weeks
Long runs forty five minutes, easy peaks
Tempo runs twice a week, twenty minutes hard
Set the foundation, never play the dead card

[Pre-Chorus]
Then anaerobic intervals, son
Thirty seconds on, thirty seconds off, runs
Eight to twelve reps, twice a week
Mimics the game stop start technique

[Chorus]
Fitness the eighty minute engine, son
Last ten minutes, the work begun
Aerobic base, anaerobic peak
Pre season pain, the fitness peak

[Verse 2]
Strength work in the gym, son, three times a week
Squat, bench press, dead lift, the legs unique
Upper body pulling, rows and chins for the back
Core stability, planks and the side plank track

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the unfit player is a passenger
Last ten minutes they are gone, the messenger
Fit players run all day, son, never stop
Fitness is the foundation of the top

[Chorus]
Fitness the eighty minute engine, son
Last ten minutes, the work begun
Aerobic base, anaerobic peak
Pre season pain, the fitness peak

[Outro]
Forty five minute base
Thirty thirty intervals chase
Gym three times, core every day
Thats my boy, build the way
